notes: Access: Tier 1 (direct HTTP via curl and WebFetch) was blocked by Cloudflare (403 Forbidden on homepage and robots.txt, from multiple IPs/UAs). Tier 2 (headless Playwright/Chromium) also returned a Cloudflare 403 block page. Escalated to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, real authenticated browser session) per hard-block rule, which loaded the site successfully (no robots.txt Claude-specific disallow could be checked since robots.txt itself was edge-blocked at all tiers, but the block is a generic Cloudflare anti-bot wall, not a targeted robots directive, so Tier 3 use is justified). Investigated the full site taxonomy: top nav (SALE, In Stock, New In, Outdoor, Furniture, Accessories, Books & Magazines, Wall Arts, Lighting, Textiles, Professional, Brands), the Accessories mega-menu (Decoration & Accessories, Kitchen & Dining, Outdoors, Storage Accessories), and the site footer (Our Story, Terms & Conditions, Contact Us, Shipping, Trade & Contract Sales, Company Profile) - no holiday/seasonal nav entries anywhere. Checked the /ar/ URL - it redirects back to /en/, confirming no separate Arabic taxonomy to inspect. Pulled the full 'Category' layered-navigation facet (via DOM extraction, not visual guess) on the four main PLPs most likely to host seasonal decor - Decoration & Accessories (Vases, Candle Holders, Decorative Items, Bowls, Lanterns, Bathroom Accessories, Mirrors, Flower Pots & Planters, Hooks & Knobs, Bins, Organizers, Racks, Candles), Kitchen & Dining (Serve ware, Cleaning Accessories, Jugs & Carafes, Tableware, Kitchenware, Drinkware, Cutlery), Wall Arts (Frames, Paintings, Art Panels, Prints), and Textiles (Outdoors, Outdoor Textiles, Outdoor Seating, Rugs, Kitchenware, Cushion, Tableware, Door Mats, Blankets, Seat Cushions, Bath Textiles, Cushions) - none contain any Christmas, Eid, Ramadan, Diwali, Halloween, Easter, Valentine's, Thanksgiving, New Year or other festival-named category. Also ran the site's internal catalog search for 'christmas' (0 results), 'ramadan' (0 results), 'eid' (0 results relevant - single hit was an unrelated product literally named 'Eida Coffee Table', a substring false-positive, not a category), 'gift' (single hit: a generic eGift Card product page, not a seasonal/gifting category), and 'new year' (returned a broad fuzzy fallback list of unrelated furniture/decor products, Magento's generic no-exact-match behavior, not a real category). The Bowery Company is a Nordic/Scandinavian design-furniture retailer (Ferm Living, HAY, &Tradition, Gubi, Normann Copenhagen, Audo Copenhagen, 101CPH, etc.) with a year-round product taxonomy organized purely by furniture/decor function; the site presents no genuine seasonal or holiday category anywhere in its navigation, facets, or search. Concluding NO_SEASONAL after this real investigation across nav, mega-menu, category facets, and search.
